source.title: OpenAPI spec for ClickHouse Cloud
source.mutability: The vendor-hosted URL is mutable. Generation fails closed unless the bytes and SHA-256 match this reviewed contract.

security_scheme.description: Use key ID and key secret obtained in ClickHouse Cloud console: https://clickhouse.com/docs/cloud/manage/openapi

auth.selected: HTTP Basic supplied only by the enrolled clickhouse_cloud connection: organization API key ID as username and key secret as password
auth.official_documentation_model: The official OpenAPI declares HTTP Basic and identifies the organization API key ID and secret as its credentials.

source_decision.reason: ClickHouse Cloud organizations, services, backups, ingestion pipelines, dashboards, alerts, and database instances are infrastructure tenancy or runtime resources. The OpenAPI does not prove a canonical task, note, or user-work project with a durable version and deletion/tombstone contract for warehouse synchronization.
